sources_read: canonical Zephaniah coordinates and received 66-book text
independently selected canonical-66 passages listed here

chunks.form: word-event superscription, genealogy, and royal synchronism
chunks.marker: Word-event formula and genealogy form a threshold before first-person oracle.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not infer authorship, royal ancestry, date, provenance, or history.
chunks.risk: Identity, genealogy, date, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: universal unmaking narrowed to Judah and Jerusalem worship
chunks.marker: Repeated remove language sweeps humans and creatures, then outstretched hand narrows to worship practices.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep universal sweep and local narrowing together; atomize no inventory and settle no cult history or ethics.
chunks.risk: Totality, cult labels, divine names, violence, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: day sacrifice, visitation catalog, city cries, and lamp-search
chunks.marker: Hush and near-day open sacrifice; on-that-day and punish clauses move through persons, districts, merchants, and complacency.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve summons-to-search progression without deciding event, chronology, collective guilt, or economics.
chunks.risk: Sacrifice, guests, officials, place names, lamp imagery, and day chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: great-day intensification hymn and judgment close
chunks.marker: Near and hastening repetition, a-day-of anaphora, trumpet, distress, and fire form a crescendo.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep crescendo intact; establish no timetable, event, violence ethic, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Day referent, scope, wealth, blood/dust, fire, ethics, chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: gathering and seeking exhortation before the decree-day
chunks.marker: Gather imperatives, repeated before clauses, threefold seek, and perhaps-hidden close cohere.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep warning and response together; settle no nation/remnant identity or salvation system.
chunks.risk: Nation descriptor, decree, seek, humility, perhaps, hiding, chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: western coastal city oracle turning toward remnant pasture
chunks.marker: Four city outcomes lead to coast woe, pasture, and remnant visitation-return.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Retain city-to-coast reversal; settle no modern identity, geography, possession, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Wordplay, Philistine/Cherethite/Canaan labels, remnant, land, ethics unresolved.

chunks.form: Moab-Ammon taunts, oath verdict, and nations-worship horizon
chunks.marker: I-have-heard opens taunts; therefore and as-I-live introduce reversal; verse 11 widens to coastlands.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep indictment, oath, and horizon together; infer no genealogy guilt, land entitlement, cult program, or theology.
chunks.risk: Moab/Ammon, Sodom comparison, remnant possession, worship and ethics unresolved.

chunks.form: southern address joined to northern imperial-city desolation
chunks.marker: One-line Cush address pivots direction; northward hand expands into Assyria/Nineveh desolation and taunt.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Prefer paired south/north close over one-verse atomization; decide no identity, history, ethics, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Cush, Assyria, Nineveh, sword agency, animals, chronology and ethics unresolved.

chunks.form: city woe, leadership indictment, and righteous-YHWH contrast
chunks.marker: Woe and four refusals lead to leadership catalog; YHWH-in-her-midst and morning justice contrast.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep failure and internal contrast together; settle no city identity, office theory, legal system, or theology.
chunks.risk: City, officials, judges, prophets, priests, law, justice and application unresolved.

chunks.form: nations precedent, failed lesson, and wait summons
chunks.marker: I-have-cut-off recital, I-said expectation, nevertheless failure, and therefore-wait conclusion form logic.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve precedent-expectation-failure logic; define no historical nations, theodicy, event, or ethics.
chunks.risk: Nation referents, wait audience, witness/prey reading, fire, chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: speech transformation, dispersed worship, and humble remnant
chunks.marker: For-then turns fire toward changed lip and united service; beyond-rivers, shame removal, remnant speech and rest follow.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep transformation parent; settle no universal language, ethnicity, remnant doctrine, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Pure-speech translation, peoples, Cush rivers, dispersed daughter, remnant and theology unresolved.

chunks.marker: Four jubilant imperatives address daughter Zion; grounds culminate in warrior-in-midst, love, and singing.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve summons and grounds; determine no Zion identity, divine-warrior doctrine, messianic identity, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Collective feminine address, king, midst, love wording, speaker, later reuse unresolved.

chunks.form: gathering, rescue, renown, and fortune-restoration coda
chunks.marker: Gather/deal/save/assemble/make clauses collect mourners, lame, outcast, shame, praise, return, and close.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep coda together; decide no preferred syntax, disability theology, land program, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Verse 18 syntax, feast/mourners, outcast, lands, fortunes/captivity wording unresolved.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Superscription becomes settled authorship, genealogy, royal descent, provenance, date, or history.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Treat it as literary-threshold evidence only; defer every identity and historical claim.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Creation reversal, sacrifice, totality, or violence becomes a harmonized event or ethics/theology system.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve rhetoric; defer scope, mechanism, ethics, event, chronology, and theology.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Day of YHWH becomes one historical or eschatological timetable, referent, or fulfillment.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Track local day language without selecting chronology or fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Nations and places collapse into fixed ancient/modern identities, borders, migrations, or claims.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain labels and directional sequence; defer identity, geography, history, politics, and fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Sword, destruction, dispossession, wrath, or fire becomes violence ethics, collective-guilt policy, or theodicy.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep accusation/reversal in larger parents; defer violence, culpability, justice, and ethics.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Unnamed city and offices become fixed history or institutional/ecclesial/political program.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve city address and contrast; defer identity, office theory, application, and theology.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Pure speech and remnant become language, ethnicity, election, perfection, or salvation doctrine.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep portrait whole; defer lexical choice, group identity, mechanism, chronology, and fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Daughter Zion, king, mourners, lame, outcast, lands, or fortunes flatten into one geopolitical/ecclesial/messianic identity.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain poetic address and motifs; defer identities, land, disability theology, chronology, and fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Canonical parallels or later reuse become dependence, graph truth, canon hierarchy, or prediction-fulfillment identity.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Relations remain non-directional evidence requiring external or human adjudication.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Hebrew roots, parsing, capitalization, translation, witness, emendation, versification, or reception settles meaning.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain alternatives and LOW confidence; source metadata is evidence only.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Book remains chapter fallbacks or atomizes into lists, images, names, and proof texts.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Use thirteen functional movements and join the one-line Cush oracle to the directional close.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Royal synchronism, superscription, Judah/Jerusalem, named worship, and reform narrative contextualize the opening.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No authorship, ancestry, date, reform alignment, history, direction, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Humans, animals, birds, fish, land, removal, mourning, and de-creation ordering cluster.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No dependence, shared event, totality ruling, chronology, or fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Near day, sacrifice, darkness, trumpet, warrior cry, fire, and reversal recur.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No shared event, timetable, eschatological system, ethics, fulfillment, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Seek, humility, righteousness, urgency, life or hiding form comparable exhortations.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No lexical flattening, works system, salvation ruling, audience identity, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Named nations and cities, directions, kinship, pride, taunt, desolation, remnant, and possession contextualize.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No identity collapse, genealogy guilt, border claim, historical harmonization, or fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Assyria/Nineveh, secure-city speech, desolation, creatures, and taunt recur in distinct settings.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No direction, empire equation, shared city/event, chronology, fulfillment, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: City woe, leaders, failed correction, justice, nations precedent, and waiting form comparable patterns.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No city identity, office harmonization, institutional program, event, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Gathered nations, fire, changed speech, shared service, distant peoples, and remnant cluster.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No Babel-reversal claim, universal language program, identity, timeline, or fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Daughter Zion, singing, fear not, king/YHWH in midst, rescue, gathering, and restored honor recur.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No Zion equation, messianic ruling, land program, timeline, fulfillment, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Later discourse reuses or resonates with Zion, king, midst, fire, city, peoples, rejoicing, and restoration.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No quotation where unproven, source direction, fulfillment identity, Israel/church equation, timetable, or hierarchy.
